applicabilityBasis.summary: JPYT is marketed for yen-denominated purchases and remittances, satisfying a payment-use indication. Its terms provide USDT/USDC redemption at the platform average lock-in exchange rate, rather than an identified issuer obligation to pay a fixed amount of national currency or a deposit. The crypto redemption and unresolved issuer identity make GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability genuinely unclear.

genius.notes: DePhaser terms do not identify a registered legal counterparty or domicile; issuerEntity and issuerDomicile remain omitted without treating incorporation as a statutory prerequisite. The independently reopened English website confirms the tracked JPYT contracts and markets payments to users worldwide, with no observed EU exclusion. USDT/USDC collateral supplied to Aave is a public protocol collateral disclosure, not an independent monthly reserve attestation. redemptionPolicyPresent is false for a fixed-fiat issuer policy; variable crypto-collateral redemption is documented. Underlying-token approvals do not transfer to JPYT. The negative authorization and action findings are limited to the reviewed public sources.

sourcesChecked: Independently reopened DePhaser JPYT design, complete September 12, 2024 Terms of Service and working English website https://dephaser.com/en; exact tracked contracts and global payment marketing confirmed.

Independently reopened OCC Bulletin 2026-3, Federal Reserve September 24 announcement updated September 29, Treasury September 30 SCRC procedural rule, and complete NYDFS regulated-entity and issuance Greenlist tables.

Named-token/project search: (CJPY OR JPYT OR APACX OR Alchemix) on OCC, FDIC, Federal Reserve, NCUA and NYDFS domains. No token-specific qualifying authorization located; FDIC academic discussion is not issuer approval.
Individual token/project searches for GENIUS approval and enforcement: CJPY/Yamato, JPYT/DePhaser, APACX LTD/PHT and Alchemix/alUSD. No qualifying token-specific authorization or action located.

Reopened Public Law 119-27, including sections 2(17), 2(22) and 3. Consulted the independently researched federal/state landscape briefs; proposed rules and SCRC procedural implementation do not approve named issuers.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no qualifying public GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, official application, issuer-announced intent or foreign registration was located for jpyt-dephaser in the independently opened token materials, NYDFS tables and named-token searches listed. This is a bounded public-evidence finding and does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. Proposed implementing rules and ordinary licensing context do not establish token-specific GENIUS authorization.
